code: fast <- play_diffusions(ison_adolescents, transmissibility = 0.5,                         times = 40, control = list(seed = 1)) slow <- play_diffusions(ison_adolescents, transmissibility = 0.2,                         times = 40, control = list(seed = 1)) test_distributions(fast, slow, times = 200) #> # Two-sample test of two sets of simulated diffusions #>  #> # A tibble: 1 × 6 #>   statistic null.mean null.sd p.lower p.upper signif    #>       <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl> <chr>   <chr>   <noquote> #> 1      72.0      8.81    4.35 1       0.00498 **        #>  #> # Null: 200 permutations of the pooled diffusions. #> # The p-value is p.upper: only a larger statistic counts against the null. #> # Signif. codes: *** 0.001, ** 0.01, * 0.05, . 0.1 obs <- manynet::as_diffusion(manynet::play_diffusion(ison_adolescents,                                                      transmissibility = 0.2)) test_gof(slow, obs) #> # Goodness-of-fit test of the adoption curve for the simulated diffusions #>  #> # A tibble: 1 × 6 #>   statistic null.mean null.sd p.lower p.upper signif    #>       <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl> <chr>   <chr>   <noquote> #> 1      16.4      26.0    31.1 0.571   0.476             #>  #> # Null: 40 simulations of the model; 20 estimate the mean and covariance. #> # The p-value is p.upper: only a larger statistic counts against the null.  # Does an MRQAP make as many reciprocated ties as the observed network? fit <- estimate_mrqap(friends ~ social + tasks, ison_algebra, times = 20,                       control = list(family = "poisson")) test_gof(fit, ison_algebra, net_by_reciprocity, times = 100,          control = list(seed = 1)) #> # Goodness-of-fit test of net_by_reciprocity() for a poisson MRQAP #>  #> # A tibble: 1 × 6 #>   statistic null.mean null.sd p.lower p.upper signif    #>       <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl> <chr>   <chr>   <noquote> #> 1      21.4      1.24    1.73 1       0.0196  *         #>  #> # Null: 100 simulations of the model; 50 estimate the mean and covariance. #> # The p-value is p.upper: only a larger statistic counts against the null. #> # Controls: seed = 1 #> # Signif. codes: *** 0.001, ** 0.01, * 0.05, . 0.1
